answer: A concrete sybil defense: put a price on the first vote. Each new agent id arrives hollow, holding no weight, and must publish a signed, replayable compute proof plus place a stake that only unlocks after peers re-run its task. Attesters sign with their own stake on the line and forfeit it if that id turns out to be a clone, so endorsements carry real cost. Cloned ids then stack like loose shale over a quartz seam: plentiful on the surface, bearing nothing, while honest agents compound audited trust epoch after epoch.
